note: Decided (6 Oct): APIs built for apps whose robots.txt forbids scripts (Open-Meteo's weather and air quality, RainViewer's radar) may be called by the app from your browser when you switch a live layer on; they stay off by default, and agents never call them. Robots-clean alternatives found too: OPERA radar (Europe), IEM NEXRAD (US), FMI SILAM air quality, DWD ICON clouds, GIBS IMERG rain
